text: The Patriots are managing several moving parts on the roster front heading into their Week 3 clash with Jacksonville: tight end Eli Raridon (thigh) and safety Craig Woodson (shoulder) both made the trip and carry questionable designations, while cornerback Carlton Davis III is set to return to action, and the team has ruled out outside linebacker Dre'Mont Jones (shoulder) and placed rookie linebacker Quintayvious Hutchins (knee) on injured reserve after initially listing him as questionable. In response to these roster adjustments, New England elevated safety Mike Brown and defensive tackle Jeremiah Pharms Jr. from the practice squad to the active roster, bolstering depth in the secondary and interior defensive line. Beyond the injury management, beat writers are noting that the Patriots must tighten their clock management before halftime—a recurring issue over the first two weeks that has drawn internal acknowledgment of the need for improvement. The Jaguars, meanwhile, are sensing opportunity against a Patriots team still finding their rhythm offensively, making this a game where New England's ability to execute late-half possessions could prove decisive.
